source_snapshot.test_set: AMD CPU RAS -PCIe Poisoned TLP TX/RX Error
source_snapshot.procedure: Uses fixed 0:0:1/core3/port0 with pcieerror errortype 6 for TX and 7 for RX under ACS/AER, literal severity and SyncFlood settings, but defines no traffic transaction that carries or consumes poison.
source_snapshot.criteria: Calls both errors correctable, accepts tool PASS and OS report within undefined timeout.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; broad log grep cannot prove poison direction, transaction consumption or application/data-path outcome and mixes unrelated PCIe error classes.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: RPUC/CHANGED; adds target/recovery gates but assumes errortype direction/severity and does not specify disposable traffic, requester/completer attribution or deterministic handling.
source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 【During Test】 Hardware required: RDIMM with ECC Plug a NIC (Network Interface Card) device on a target PCIe slot on the SUT / HDT Software tool: AMD RAS Error Injection Tool 1. BIOS settings: a. NBIO Common options → ACS Enable: Enable b. NBIO Common options → Enable AER Cap: Enable c. AMD PBS → RAS → Pcie Root Port UnCorr Error Sev Reg: 7EF6030 d. AMD PBS → RAS → Pcie Device UnCorr Error Sev Reg: 7EF6030 e. FCH Common Options → FCH RAS Options → Reset After Sync-Flood: Enable f. NBIO Common Options → NBIO RAS Common Options → SyncFlood on PCIe Fatal Error: True 2. Unlock CPU via HDT. 3. Boot into Ubuntu 20.04/RHEL 2022. 4. Download the AMD RAS Error Injection Tool, then install and open the software. 5. Execute the following command to get a list of devices in the PCIe slots: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --listpcieslotinfo 6. PCIe Poisoned TLP TX Error, enter the following commands: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --pcieerror --sockdienbio 0:0:1 --errortype 6 --pciecore 3 --pcieport 0 7. PCIe Poisoned TLP RX Error, enter the following commands: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --pcieerror --sockdienbio 0:0:1 --errortype 7 --pciecore 3 --pcieport 0 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria_direct_xlsx: 1. For correctable errors, the tool provides a PASS status. 2. If the OS reports the error within a timeout period, the test passed. 3. If the OS does not report the error within a timeout period, the test failed.
source_snapshot.deepseek_direct_xlsx: PARTIAL | -- PCIe slot 1~N: inject the PCIe Poisoned TLP on PCIe slot 1~N via the AMD RAS Error Injection Tool (after HDT/unlock + the BIOS RAS knobs from the procedure, e.g. Platform First Error Handling=Enabled + per-unit MCA/UMC settings). Agent stages/verifies with sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "dmesg -T 2>&1 | tail -160 | grep -iE 'pcier|aer|ecrc|lcrc|poisoned|fatal'; echo __PCIe_Poisoned_TLP_on_PCIe_slot_1~N; ipmitool sel elist 2>&1 | tail -40 2>&1" but the tool injection step itself is interactive/HW-level and needs the user to drive the exact inject command.

disposition_reason: A poison injection is not demonstrated merely by arming an error bit; an identified transaction must carry the poisoned payload to an observable consumer. TX and RX labels depend on the injection port's perspective and must be reconciled with requester/completer roles. Because errortype 6 appears under another command family with different targeting, the number alone cannot establish identical semantics or severity. test_case.test_name: PCIe slot 1~N — retained controlled review-layer procedure
test_case.purpose: Verify Poisoned-TLP handling in both transmit and receive directions for every required PCIe slot, proving the poison traverses an approved disposable transaction, is attributed to the intended path and produces the defined correctable/non-fatal consumer outcome without persistent link or data corruption.
required_package: Physical slot/NIC serial/FW/driver/BDF to socket/die/NBIO/core/port map for each target
AMD tool/spec proof that pcieerror errortype 6/7 select Poisoned-TLP TX/RX and their severity
Requester/completer and transmitter/receiver roles plus a disposable bounded transaction that actually carries and consumes poison
Expected AER status/source ID/severity and process/packet/I/O/checksum outcome per direction
Decoded 7EF6030, masks, DPC/SyncFlood policy and correctable-versus-nonfatal decision
Supported OS, timeout, aborts, OOB recovery, RDIMM relevance and restoration
test_case.test_command: Map each NIC/slot to BDF and NBIO/core/port; obtain authoritative pcieerror 6/7 direction and severity semantics; define transmitter, receiver, requester/completer and a disposable checksum-protected transaction; baseline AER/link/device/process state; inject TX once and correlate the consumed transaction and source; recover fully, then separately inject RX; verify severity, application/I/O outcome, no fatal escalation and restored data/link health; restore BIOS/HDT/AER state.
test_case.expected_result: 1. For correctable errors, the tool provides a PASS status. 2. If the OS reports the error within a timeout period, the test passed. 3. If the OS does not report the error within a timeout period, the test failed.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No executable PASS verdict exists yet for PCIe slot 1~N. The protected Criteria is `1. For correctable errors, the tool provides a PASS status. 2. If the OS reports the error within a timeout period, the test passed. 3. If the OS does not report the error within a timeout period, the test failed.`; it becomes enforceable only after resolving: Resolve Reliability row 67 Wistron-System RAS-00787-V002: provide per-slot NIC/BDF-to-NBIO/core/port mapping and vendor proof pcieerror errortype 6/7 mean Poisoned-TLP TX/RX, including relation to einjbiopcie errortype 6; decide correctable/nonfatal severity; define requester/completer roles, isolated poison-consuming transaction, exact AER and process/I/O/checksum outcomes; approve 7EF6030/masks/DPC/SyncFlood, supported OS, timeout, aborts, OOB recovery, RDIMM relevance and restoration.
safety_gate: Dedicated quiesced NIC/link with independent OOB management and no production or persistent data traffic
Verify live tuple and dependency path; use only disposable checksum-protected buffers/packets
Execute TX and RX separately and restore known-good link/device/process state between directions
Abort on wrong source, unexpected data modification, fatal/DPC/SyncFlood escalation, driver reset, link loss or host reset
No automatic retry; preserve evidence and restore/diff BIOS/HDT/AER/SyncFlood and NIC state
expected_evidence: Exact NIC/slot/BDF/NBIO path and dependency identity
Tool/spec direction/severity mapping plus decoded AER policy
Disposable transaction, roles, buffer/packet identity and checksum baseline
Separate TX and RX transcripts with exact AER source/status/severity
Consumer/application/I/O outcome and no fatal escalation or persistent link/data impact
Restored state and engineer verdict per direction
test_case.recovery: If no safe transaction can consume poison for a device class, retain that target as pending rather than injecting without an observable consumer. Do not equate pcieerror 6 with einjbiopcie 6 without vendor documentation.

source_conflict.reason: Criteria call Poisoned TLP correctable without defining severity; pcieerror 6/7 TX/RX meanings lack authority and differ from einjbiopcie usage. Slot 1~N uses one tuple, no transaction consumes poison, requester/completer attribution and deterministic outcome are absent, 7EF6030 is undecoded, timeout/RHEL 2022 and RDIMM relevance are ambiguous.
